Introduction.SourceString: 令伊波恩众人和街坊邻居感到安心的完美管家。
Introduction.LocalizedString: The perfect butler who brings peace of mind to everyone at Eibon and the neighborhood.

Content.SourceString:
阿德勒先生，全名阿洛伊斯·V·阿德勒，不过至今没有人会连名带姓的直呼这位看起来就很值得尊敬的管家。在伊波恩古董店，管家是一个非常复杂的职业，日常工作内容包括但不限于：准备口味完全不同的七份早餐并让挑食的小孩多吃蔬菜，及时清点和补充店内酒和解酒药的储备，为了完成委托而不得不造成额外损失的应对方案，面对店铺账户余额时保持良好心态的修行…… 
总之，能拥有这样一位管家真是幸运啊。

金牌剑术家，十环射艺证书，高级茶道导师以及桥间地纸飞机大赛冠军——海特洛市真正的考证大师，「全能」从不只是说说而已。娜娜莉曾经发起一项名为「万能的阿德勒先生究竟不会什么？」的挑战赛，赢家将获得由柯林斯家族提供的「终身荣誉成员」名号一份。该比赛最终由娜娜莉的「阿德勒先生一定没有捣蛋过！」赢得胜利，虽然作为柯林斯家族的一代目似乎并不需要这份奖励？至于阿德勒先生是不是真的没有捣蛋过……怎么想都是没有吧。

「大叔对不起，我下次一定会注意花盆的位置，绝对不会打碎第68个花盆的！！！」
「第67个花盆碎掉的时候你也这么说。」
「Taygedo.（伊波恩花盆破坏大师。）」
「无妨，只是一个花盆而已，植物也并未伤到根系，换个新的就好。」
「那新的花盆就用我的零花钱买吧！」
在刚陷入黑暗的那段时间里，阿德勒也曾失手打碎过一个花盆，一个价值一年零四个月又十三天「零花钱」的花盆。当然也多亏了这段经历，从那之后阿德勒先生再也没有失手打碎过任何东西。
Content.LocalizedString:
Adler, full name Alois V. Adler. Although no one has ever called this clearly respectable butler by his full name. At Eibon, being a butler is an incredibly difficult job. Daily duties include but are not limited to: preparing seven completely different breakfasts and getting picky kids to eat their vegetables, keeping track of and restocking the store's alcohol and hangover remedy supplies, damage control plans for unavoidable losses during commissions, maintaining a positive attitude when facing the shop's account balance…
All in all, any one is lucky to have a butler like him.

Gold medal swordsman, ten-ring archery certificate, advanced tea ceremony instructor, and Bridge Crossings Paper Plane Competition champion. Hethereau's true certification master, "perfect" is never just talk. Nanally once started a challenge called "What can't the amazing Adler do?" with the winner receiving a "Lifetime Honorary Member" title from the Coluccis. Nanally herself won the competition: "Mr. Adler has definitely never caused trouble!" Though as the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, she probably didn't need that reward. As for whether Adler has ever caused any trouble… one would think not.

"Sorry, old man! I'll definitely watch where I put the flowerpots next time, I won't break the sixty-eighth one!"
"You said the same thing when the sixty-seventh one broke."
"Taygedo (Eibon's flowerpot destruction master).” 
"It's fine, it's just a pot. The roots weren't damaged. We'll just get a new one."
"Then I'll buy the new pot with my allowance!"
During the days when he first fell into darkness, Adler once accidentally broke a flowerpot too, one worth one year, four months, and thirteen days of "allowance." Thanks to that, Adler has never accidentally broken anything since.

Content.SourceString:
「今天也是阿德勒先生来打扫储藏室吗？」
「是的。」
拿着清洁工具的青年站在一旁让出路来，衣着整洁的女佣轻声向他道谢，并善意地提醒他注意身前台阶，又脚步匆匆地离开了。毕竟这个庭院里收留了太多这样的人，只是这一点点微小的善意都显得珍贵。目盲的青年静静地站在储藏室门口，直到女佣的脚步声消失后才踏入储藏室中，一边摸索一边用软布擦去物件上的尘埃。仆从们都不喜欢打扫这里，毕竟这是一项很无趣的工作，但阿德勒并不在意。打扫对他来说算得上是一件很轻松的工作了，不需要与人交谈，安静的环境让他感到格外放松。尽管因为目盲的缺陷，他往往要花上更多的时间。好在这间储藏室里并没什么太过脆弱的藏品，只需要小心一些就好，阿德勒很珍惜这份来之不易的工作。
藏品们沉默地注视着忙碌的青年，他并没有偏爱哪样藏品，每一件他都打扫得很认真，但要说起来，每当擦拭到那副高悬的盔甲时，他总会打扫得更细致一些。阿德勒曾听到关于这副名为「圆觉」的盔甲的故事，拥有强大力量的盔甲和战无不胜的勇士们，那些故事在他瘦削的胸膛中灼烧着，或许他也有一天……每当想到这里，阿德勒便会平静地将每一片鳞甲擦得越发干净。
平淡的日子一直持续到了某一个雪夜，沉寂许久的盔甲幽幽地散发着光芒，似鹿非鹿的空若们从圆觉中诞生，踏着落下的雪花围绕在沉睡的青年身边。
「新的……主人？」
「喜欢！」
「熟悉的味道。」
「……嗯。」
「依老朽所见……」
它们的聊天声并没有惊醒熟睡中的人，那便让这个梦再长些，待到第二日雪霁初晴再告诉青年这个好消息吧。
Content.LocalizedString:
"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.

Content.SourceString: 作为最常出现的空若，「色」在伊波恩拥有自己的专属昵称——「小物」，是继塔吉多，埃德嘉，早雾之后柯林斯家族的第五位预备成员，虽然小物并不能理解这些，但不影响它很喜欢这个名字，而且听起来和空若的叫声也很像。无论是准备餐食还是打扫卫生，小物都是阿德勒先生的好帮手。至于帮忙的报酬……摸摸它的脑袋，并奖励它一块胡萝卜蛋糕就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: As the most frequently appearing Sunya, Rupa has its own special nickname at Eibon: "Little Thing." It's the fifth provisional member of The Coluccis, following Taygedo, Edgar, and Sakiri. Although Little Thing doesn't understand what this means, it still loves the name. Whether it's preparing meals or cleaning up, Little Thing is Mr. Adler's best helper. As for payment for its help… just pat its head and reward it with a slice of carrot cake.

Content.SourceString: 若要说跟伊波恩的关系最好的空若，那必然是「受」。漫画BE时的陪哭员，双人联机游戏的好队友，零点夜宵的好搭档！比起其它的空若，「受」的情感似乎格外充沛，但实际上空若并没有鲜明的情感，「受」只是善于感受他人的情绪并模仿出来。曾经有段时间「受」对此很是困惑，因为他人的喜悦而喜悦，因为他人的痛苦而痛苦，那它自己的情感又从何而来呢？它这样问着圆觉的主人。至于阿德勒先生是如何回答的，「受」已经不记得了，但它记得那天的胡萝卜蛋糕很好吃，而这份喜悦的感情只来自于它自己。
Content.LocalizedString: If you had to name the Sunya closest to Eibon, it would definitely be Vedana. Vedana is a sucker for tragic manga endings, a great teammate for co-op games, and the perfect partner for scarfing down midnight snacks. Compared to other Sunyas, Vedana seems to have particularly rich emotions, but actually, Sunyas don't have distinct feelings. Vedana is just good at sensing others' emotions and mimicking them. There was a time when Vedana was quite puzzled by this. Feeling joy because of others' happiness, feeling pain because of others' suffering… where did its own emotions come from? It asked this question to Enlightenment's master. Vedana can't remember how Adler answered anymore, but it remembers that the carrot cake that day was delicious, and that feeling of joy came from itself alone.

Content.SourceString:
伊波恩的日子大多时候都很平淡，阿德勒先生也不会强硬地要求空若们做什么。于是在没有委托的日子里，它们拥有了自己的爱好。「想」最喜欢画，每当伊波恩收到古董画作时，它总会第一个上前，辨别真假，保养收纳。有天，阿德勒先生送了它一份画具，也是从那天起，呗果上多了一位名为「想」的画家。据说只是看到它的画，就能听到声音，闻到味道，尝到味道。可惜至今没有哪家藏馆能拥有或仅仅只是展出一次「想」的画作。
「想」将自己的第一幅画送给了阿德勒先生，尽管那只是一张踩着几个蹄印的纸，像下雪一样。
Content.LocalizedString:
Most days at Eibon are pretty peaceful. Adler doesn't force the Sunyas to do anything. So on days without commissions, they have their own hobbies. Sanna loves to paint. Whenever Eibon receives antique paintings, Sanna is always the first to step forward, identifying authenticity and handling storage. One day, Adler gave Sanna a set of art supplies. From that day on, Sanna became Bagel's newest artist. They say that just one look at Sanna's paintings would make you hear sounds, smell scents, and taste flavors. Unfortunately, no Collection Hall has ever been able to own or even display one of Sanna's works.
Sanna gave its very first painting to Adler, even though it was just a piece of paper with a few hoof prints on it, imprinted like falling snow.

Content.SourceString:
「行」是「圆觉」中出现的第二只空若，因战火造业而诞生。每一代圆觉的主人总有所求，业火终日灼烧着鳞甲，空若们渐渐都陷入沉睡，而「行」愈发的清醒，毕竟这便是它诞生的意义。一直到混乱的时代过去，这副盔甲成为了一种象征，直至被遗忘在昏暗的储藏室中。有时会有佣人或门客驻足在圆觉面前，诉说自己的渴望，但在饮过那样滚烫的仇恨后，生于和平年代的愿望大多都显得无趣，圆觉仍然沉默。「行」有时会想，它是不是也该像它的「兄弟们」那样睡去。
好在「行」很喜欢下雪的日子，也好在在「行」准备欣赏完这最后一场雪睡去前，它听到了一个愿望，一个远比拥有一座城池还要贪婪得多的愿望——「我有很多很多想守护的东西。」
总之，圆觉回应了那个盲眼的孩子，「行」也不得不遵循这位新主人的想法。而现在「行」的日常工作是照顾孩子，以及凭借它惊人的速度去抢今日的折扣商品。
Content.LocalizedString:
Sankhara is the second Sunya to appear in "Enlightenment," and was born from the karma created by war and conflict. Each generation of Enlightenment's masters always had desires, and the fires of karma burned the armor scales day and night. The Sunya gradually fell into slumber, while Sankhara became increasingly awake, since this was the very meaning of its birth. Until the chaotic times passed and this armor became a symbol, eventually forgotten in a dim storage room. Sometimes servants or guests would pause before Enlightenment, speaking their desires to it, but after drinking such burning hatred, most wishes born in peaceful times seemed boring. Enlightenment remained silent. Sankhara sometimes wondered if it too should sleep like its "siblings."
Fortunately, Sankhara really liked snowy days, and fortunately, just as Sankhara was preparing to enjoy one last snowfall before sleeping, it heard a wish, one far more greedy than owning an entire city: "I have so many, many things I want to protect."
In any case, Enlightenment responded to that blind child, and Sankhara had no choice but to follow this new master's way of thinking. Now Sankhara's daily work is taking care of children and using its amazing speed to snag the day's discount items.

Content.SourceString:
「识」很少出现在外人面前，大部分时候它都懒洋洋的在「圆觉」中睡觉，毕竟作为第一个出现在阿德勒先生身边的空若——「老朽已经没那么多精力了」，它总是这么说。至于是真的因为时间漫长而疲倦还是别的什么原因，大概只有「识」自己知道了。不过在谈及阿德勒先生的时候，「识」倒是很乐意多说两句。
「阿洛伊斯啊……那孩子为了见我，天天就睡在廊下，也不说话。也是老朽心善，看不得小孩子受苦，才勉强回应了他，谁知道这孩子之后……」
接下来便是「识」絮絮叨叨得讲述这些年来他的不易，而关于阿德勒先生的也只有这么两句。
Content.LocalizedString:
Vinnana rarely appears before outsiders. Most of the time, it sleeps lazily inside Enlightenment. After all, it was the first Sunya to appear by Mr. Adler's side. "This old one doesn't have that much energy anymore," it always says. Whether it's truly tired from the passage of time or for some other unknown reason, only Vinnana itself knows. However, when it comes to talking about Adler, Vinnana is quite willing to say a few more words.
"Alois, ah… Just to see me, that child would sleep in the corridor every day without saying a word. It was this old one's kind heart, who couldn't bear to see a child suffer, that reluctantly responded to him. Who knew that child would later…"
What follows is Vinnana rambling on about hardships over the years, and those are about what it'd speak of Adler.

Content.SourceString: 您好，欢迎光临「伊波恩」，鄙人是这里的管家阿洛伊斯·V·阿德勒，您称呼我为「阿德勒」就好。有任何需要，可随时告知于我，很乐意为您效劳。
Content.LocalizedString: Welcome to Eibon. I'm Alois V. Adler, the butler. Please, call me Adler. If you need anything, let me know. I'm at your service.

Content.SourceString: 这个月的营业额……不容乐观啊。
Content.LocalizedString: This month's revenue… is not looking too promising.

Content.SourceString: 酒、糖果、漫画书、游戏卡带、防锈油……嗯，都买齐了。
Content.LocalizedString: Booze, candy, manga, game cartridges, anti-rust oil… yup, that's everything.
Thank you all for the help today.

Content.SourceString: 适合出游的好天气，为娜娜莉他们准备些便当吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's perfect weather for an outing. I should prepare some bento boxes for Nanally and the others.

Content.SourceString: 看来天气预报也未必总是那么准确，找个地方避避雨吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems weather forecasts aren't always reliable. Let's find somewhere to wait out the rain.

Content.SourceString: 要提醒大家添加衣物了，感冒药也备一份。
Content.LocalizedString: I should remind everyone to dress more warmly, and I'll prepare some cold medicine just in case.

Content.SourceString: 炎热天气最忌贪凉，闹肚子的滋味可不好受。
Content.LocalizedString: One shouldn't indulge in too much cooling off in hot weather—stomach aches are rather unpleasant, after all.

Content.SourceString: 早上好，昨晚休息得如何？早餐已经准备好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning. How's your rest? Come for breakfast when you're ready.

Content.SourceString: 有什么想吃的吗？我来准备。
Content.LocalizedString: Anything you'd like to eat? I'll get cooking.

Content.SourceString: 一般这个时候不会再有客人上门了，自由时间做点自己想做的事情吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, relax. It's our free time now, customers usually don't come at these hours.

Content.SourceString: 充足的睡眠是保证身体健康的前提之一……当然，如果想要再跟人聊聊的话，我也随时都在。
Content.LocalizedString: Getting enough sleep is essential for maintaining good health… Of course, if you'd like to chat more, I'm always here.

Content.SourceString: 烹饪也是一种修行，从食材的挑选到加工处理、火候的掌控、调料的配置，直到端上桌收到食客们的评价，这场修行才算暂时结束。于我而言，为伊波恩的大家准备餐食最是满足和愉快，当然……如果早雾能少挑些食，就更好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Cooking is a discipline—from selecting ingredients to receiving feedback, each meal is a journey. I love preparing meals for everyone at Eibon, though it would be better if Sakiri were less picky.

Content.SourceString: 烦恼么？嗯——像是店里这个月又赤字了，小姐又买到了假古董，或是娜娜莉他们又施行了什么让邻里们找上门来的「大计划」，坦诚来说，有时我也会略微有些头疼……不过比起这些小意外，还是更担心大家因为眼前的要紧事而忘了顾及自身安危——作为伊波恩的管家，这方面我自然应该多费些心。
Content.LocalizedString: Troubles? The shop's running at a deficit, my lady bought another counterfeit antique, and Nanally's schemes bring the neighbors to our doorstep. These things give me a headache, but I worry more about everyone neglecting their well-being. As Eibon's butler, I pay extra attention to such concerns.

Content.SourceString: 大部分歧骸其实都很友善，只是不知道怎么表达，或者说跟我们习惯的方式有所不同。如果有机会的话，不妨试着和它们沟通沟通，也许能看到一个完全不同的世界。
Content.LocalizedString: Most Oddities are actually quite friendly—they just don't know how to express themselves, or perhaps their ways are different from what we're used to. If you get the chance, try communicating with them. You might just discover a completely different world.

Content.SourceString: 整洁的着装往往能给人留下好印象，不过，每个人都有自己的喜好。礼节真正的要义在于关怀他人的感受，而非过分强调自己的习惯。强求他人按照自身的原则行事，反倒是最容易失礼的地方。
Content.LocalizedString: Neat attire leaves a good impression, but true etiquette is about considering others' feelings and not imposing our habits. Forcing others to follow our principles is the greatest breach of etiquette.

Content.SourceString: 快速处理好所有事情的「秘诀」吗……常规事务我习惯提前做好清单，按计划处理就好，偶尔也会有些出乎意料的情况，那个时候，就得靠一些耐心和运气了……大概是经历得多了，总能找到相似的应对措施吧。
Content.LocalizedString: The secret to handling everything quickly? For routine matters, I simply prepare lists in advance and follow the plan. Sometimes unexpected situations do arise—that's when patience and a bit of luck come in handy… I suppose with enough experience, you start to recognize patterns in how to handle things.

Content.SourceString: 这副甲胄名曰「圆觉」，非我所有，我也只是机缘巧合之下恰好能够使用它而已。空若平日里就寄居在这幅甲胄之中，说起来也很幸运，有了空若的帮助，家务活也轻松了很多。
Content.LocalizedString: This armor is called Enlightenment. It's not mine; I'm just fortunate enough to use it. Sunya resides within it, making household chores easier.

Content.SourceString: 我或许很难真正中立地评价异能又或是异象的好坏，毕竟我自己算是十足的受益者……多数人与我初见时或多或少会感到疑惑吧，为何我眼盲，却能正常感知到周围的人和事，于生活无碍。从前我不过是一个普通盲人，很多事情还要假借他人才能做到。是「圆觉」让我拥有了特殊的洞悉世界的能力，同时也有了护守之责。
Content.LocalizedString: It would be difficult for me to have a truly neutral stance on Esper abilities or anomalies, as I undoubtedly have vested interests with them… Most people are puzzled when they first meet me, wondering how a blind man can perceive the world around him with such clarity. I was once just an ordinary blind person, dependent on others for many things. It was the Enlightenment that gifted me with this special ability to perceive the world, and with it, a duty to protect.

Content.SourceString: 这幅眼镜么？是娜娜莉加入伊波恩后，用委托挣到的第一笔零花钱买来赠与我的。「电影里的『斯文暴徒管家』，都是这么打扮的」，她这么说着，眉飞色舞，神采奕奕。见她兴致正高，我也就收下了这份特殊的心意。 至于她自己的那副，则是为了更有……「家族一代目的气质」……？这样的礼物，真是很有娜娜莉的风格。
Content.LocalizedString: These glasses? Nanally bought them for me with her first earnings from commissions after joining Eibon. She was absolutely beaming when she said, "This is how the gentleman thug dresses in movies!" Seeing her so excited, I couldn't help but accept this unique gesture. As for her own pair, she got them to embody more of a… "Ichi-daime boss" vibe? Such gifts are quite in style with Nanally.

Content.SourceString: ……全能……么？真是谬赞了。我不过是虚长些年岁，见过的人和事更多一点。像我还在娜娜莉他们这个年纪的时候，是万万没有他们的活力和胆识的。
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect, huh? You're far too kind. I simply have a few more years behind me, having seen a bit more of the world. When I was their age, I dreamed of being as bright as they are now.

Content.SourceString: 小姐她……背负了很多，说来惭愧，我所能做的不过是些日常琐事，但是只要能替小姐分担一些，也是我的荣幸了。
Content.LocalizedString: My lady carries many burdens… I'm ashamed to say I can only help with mundane matters, but it's my honor to shoulder even a small portion of her responsibilities.

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉是一个很纯粹的孩子，托她的福，伊波恩也逐渐变得热闹起来了，要是遇事她能再多……我并不是说吵闹的意思，正相反，他们这个年纪正是玩耍的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally is a simple kid. Thanks to her, Eibon has become much more lively. I wish when things happen, she would be more… But I'm not complaining about the noise. This is exactly the age when they should be playing around.

Content.SourceString: 早雾只是不那么擅长直接表达内心的情感，这样敏感通透的孩子，比起言语上的沟通，行为往往更直接地展现着她的真实想法。很多时候，她都并非像她刻意表现地那样满不在意——保持适当的距离，给予她足够的空间，反而能让她慢慢敞开心扉。
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri isn't great at expressing her feelings directly. For someone as sensitive as her, actions speak louder than words. She often cares more than she shows. Giving her space helps her open up gradually.

Content.SourceString: 不善交际也并非什么坏事，每个人都有自己的生活习惯，埃德嘉自身也不会因为与他人沟通困难而一再烦恼，这样就很好。更何况，他的身边一直都有最懂他的早雾和娜娜莉，她们会是他最好的倾听者。
Content.LocalizedString: Being unsociable isn't necessarily a bad thing—everyone has their own way of living, and Edgar himself isn't troubled by his difficulty in communicating with others, which is perfectly fine. Besides, he has Sakiri and Nanally by his side who understand him best, and they'll always be his most attentive listeners.

Content.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔对小姐极其赤诚，涉及到小姐的事情，她都亲力亲为，是值得托付的人。多亏有她的帮衬，我才能有余力处理些琐事……只是有时候，我也希望她能多关心自己一些。
Content.LocalizedString: Daffodill shows unwavering loyalty to my lady, handling all matters concerning her personally—she's someone we can truly rely on. Thanks to her support, I can focus on taking care of other tasks… Though sometimes, I wish she would take better care of herself too.

Content.SourceString: 要感谢塔吉多平日里也经常帮忙处理店内事务，尤其是那些小发明，都很有趣。别看平日里早雾、娜娜莉乃至小姐嘴上都说着违心的玩笑话，要把塔吉多拿去抵债——要是一阵子没看到塔吉多，她们都会忍不住主动问起。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm grateful for Taygedo's regular help around the shop, especially those interesting little inventions of his. Though Sakiri, Nanally, and even my lady joke about selling him to settle debts, they can't help but ask about him when he hasn't been around for a while.

Content.SourceString: 最初的伊波恩也没这么热闹，刚到半角街落脚的时候，这里还是一片凋敝，早雾那时候不太爱说话，小姐和达芙蒂尔也有很多事情要忙。后来发现了塔吉多，再到后来娜娜莉和埃德嘉加入，这里也渐渐多了欢声笑语。现在又有了鉴定师，我想如今的伊波恩，对大家而言，也算是一个能遮风挡雨的地方了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon wasn't always this lively. When we first settled on Hankaku Street, it was run-down. Sakiri barely spoke, and both my lady and Daffodill were busy. Things changed when we found Taygedo, and even more when Nanally and Edgar joined. The shop was filled with warmth and laughter. Now, with Appraiser here, Eibon feels like a true home.
Learning knows no bounds.
Could never stop improving.
A moment worth remembering.

Content.SourceString: 相当称心的礼物，鉴定师有心了。
Content.LocalizedString: What a wonderful gift. Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: ……只是想起了一些旧事，我很喜欢这份珍礼，多谢。
Content.LocalizedString: I was just reminded of some things in the past… I like the gift a lot. Thanks.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师的品味一向令人称道。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I've always known you had great taste.

Content.SourceString: 礼物与情意都值得好好珍藏。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll treasure the gift and the effort you put in.
Enlighten.
Dispel.
Comprehend.
Everything with form is unreal.
Selfless, formless.
May you find eternal peace.
I'll take care of the cleanup work.
Thanks for your hard work.

Content.SourceString: 要来点什么补充能量吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Need something to recharge your energy?

Content.SourceString: 好好休息吧，剩下交给我。
Content.LocalizedString: Go take a break. I'll handle the rest.
Worth adding to the collection.

Content.SourceString: 意外之喜，看来今天是个好日子。
Content.LocalizedString: What a pleasant surprise—today is turning out to be quite a good day.

Content.SourceString: 没见过的藏品，带回去看看吧。
Content.LocalizedString: An unfamiliar collectible— should take it back for a closer look.
Looks like we might turn a profit this month.

Content.SourceString: 今晚改善一下伙食如何？
Content.LocalizedString: How about we have something special for dinner tonight?

Content.SourceString: 相当不错的成色，留下吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Quite good quality. Let's keep it.
That's unexpected.
Don't worry, I'm fine.
Please stand behind me.
Feeling better now.
All is well.
We can go… further…
Please… take care of them…
Sorry to disappoint you.
Are you alright?
Haven't lost my edge yet.
My mistake.
Be careful.
This could be trouble.
Difficult situation.
Good to get some exercise.
How may I be of service.
Prolonged fights serve no purpose.
Let's finish this quickly.
All but an illusion.
Is the wind picking up?
Very convenient way to travel.
Rest for a moment.
Good thing I'm not late.
I won't let you down.
Miss, allow me to handle this.
Well done, Nanally.
Sakiri, stay safe.

Content.SourceString: 需要保养一下电脑零件吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Need me to service your computer parts?
Shift change. Good work.
I'll protect you.
Miss! This is my fault…
Nanally, don't push yourself!

Content.SourceString: 鬼郎丸也需要消化时间。
Content.LocalizedString: Even Kiroumaru needs time to digest.

Content.SourceString: 已经做得够好了，埃德嘉。
Content.LocalizedString: You've done well, Edgar.
Daffodill, thank you for your hard work.

Content.SourceString: 你已经做得很好了鉴定师，剩下的交给我吧。
Content.LocalizedString: You did well, Appraiser. Leave the rest to me.
Precise choice.
Sharp as ever.
I've learned something.
Patience over haste.
